id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

inputText.description: The text to overwrite the input of the chat component

headerText.description: The header text of the chat box component

serverMessageHeader.description: The header of each chat message sent by the server

userMessageHeader.description: The header of each message sent by the user

expandable.description: Whether the chat box can be expanded to full screen

clearable.description: Whether the chat box can be cleared

searchableMessages.description:
Whether the search icon appears on user messages, allowing them to initiate a search query
using the original message as the query

dateFormat.description: The format of the datetime displayed on each message

allowFeedback.description: Whether feedback is allowed for chat messages sent by the server

expanded.description: Whether the chat is in expanded view

header.description: The title of the chat box component

messages.description: All of the chat messages sent in the chat

latestMessage.description:
The latest chat message sent in the chat. Not actually used for rendering. Instead,
the latest message is just appended to the #messages inside the reducer
#chatUpdateEffect. Still needed a field for the dataSpec to point to as the
`dataDestinationField` without it being #messages because it will just override
and we want it to append.

uiSettings.description: UI Settings dependent on the backend configuration

showBanner.description: Whether the filter status banner is shown in the chat

readOnly.description:
Whether the chat should be in read only mode, used in the conversation history page.
In read only mode, the user cannot send messages, give feedback, query from a message, or delete the chat contents.

conversation.description: Represents the queries and messages the chat will initially be populated with.
